messages:
Ava (Product PM): Quick review — API Keys page v-next. Main focus: create/rotate/revoke flows, empty state copy, and a11y. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zz/api-keys-new

Sam (Design): Proposed empty state: headline 'Create your first API key' + three starter cards (Server, Client, Local). CTA text: 'Create API key' not 'New Key'. Use 'Rotate' instead of 'Regenerate'.

Jordan (Frontend): Dev notes: never render raw key in table. Show masked value and Reveal on demand. Copy button aria-label='Copy API key' and toast must not include the key value.

Maria (Security): Require one-time reveal for rotated keys and checkbox 'I have saved this key' before finish. Revoke modal copy: 'Revoking stops any requests using this key immediately.' Require re-auth if last activity >15m. Log all rotate/revoke actions.

Rohit (DevEx): Analytics: key_create, key_revealed, rotate_started, rotate_confirmed, revoke_requested, revoke_confirmed, empty_cta_clicked. Also track which starter card chosen.

Kai (Accessibility): Masked token reveal must be keyboard-accessible (Enter/Space), have role='button' and aria-expanded. Announce reveals via polite live region: 'API key revealed; will hide in 10 seconds'. Ensure badge contrast meets WCAG AA.

Sam (Design): Microcopy tweak for revoke modal: add 'See audit log' link and a small hint 'Consider rotating if you need a quick replacement'. Also show owner column for team keys.

Jordan (Frontend): Implementation plan: server returns new key once on rotate; client shows in modal input readonly, autocomplete=off. Auto-hide after 10s if revealed. Throttle client copy attempts and surface copy_attempt events.

Maria (Security): Toasts: generic text only. Rate-limit reveals/copies server-side and alert if suspicious. Team keys require owner field; only owners can revoke without extra approval.

Ava (Product PM): Can we A/B test empty-state wording? Variant A: security-first. Variant B: speed-first. Also add small 'Why masked?' tooltip linked to masked token.

Sam (Design): Agree. Also change button labels to use plain language: 'Reveal key', 'Rotate key', 'Revoke key'.
